day_shape: 59 items: State Dept sanctions Zanjani financial-evasion network and EU designates five Iranian judges, IRGC claims Operation Victory 2 strikes on Al-Udeid, Ali al-Salem and Arbil bases, Araghchi at SCO in Kyrgyzstan, WSJ/satellite reports Iran rebuilding damaged sites, Germany scales back Tehran embassy.

threads.label: IRGC claims strikes on US regional bases
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried successive IRGC statements (numbers 47–50 of 'Operation Victory 2') claiming strikes on Al-Udeid, Ali al-Salem in Kuwait, US accommodation in Jordan, a Patriot battery and command sites in Arbil, and an Amazon building in Bahrain. IRIB also reported explosions heard in Saudi Arabia and Jask, and the IRGC warned regional populations to move away from US base perimeters.

threads.label: Western sanctions and diplomatic pressure on Iran
threads.summary: The US State Department announced sanctions on Babak Zanjani's financial-evasion network for enabling Iranian sanctions evasion and IRGC financing, while the EU sanctioned five Iranian judges and a cyber-group figure over human rights violations. Germany scaled back its Tehran embassy operations and again urged its citizens to leave Iran, and the US Treasury separately designated a Muslim Brotherhood official and entities accused of financing Hamas.

threads.label: Araghchi diplomacy at SCO and BRICS
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi met counterparts from China, Egypt and Kyrgyzstan on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation ministerial in Kyrgyzstan, saying SCO members had condemned 'American aggressions' against Iran. Interior Minister Momeni told a BRICS meeting members should condemn US strikes on Iranian infrastructure and defend state sovereignty.

threads.label: Iran reconstruction and Hormuz costs reported
threads.summary: The Wall Street Journal, cited by Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post, reported satellite imagery shows Iran has rebuilt bridges and missile bases damaged in US and Israeli strikes faster than expected. Iran International, citing Chinese customs data, reported Iran bore the biggest economic cost from its closure of the Strait of Hormuz, with its own China trade hit harder than Gulf neighbours'.

threads.label: West Bank attack, Gaza strikes, Red Sea shipping
threads.summary: The IDF said it eliminated the gunman behind a shooting near Tell in the West Bank that killed two Israelis, and reported overnight airstrikes on Hamas weapons depots, manufacturing sites and tunnels in Gaza. UN Secretary-General Guterres said he was 'deeply alarmed' by resumed Houthi attacks on Red Sea vessels, and Jerusalem Post reported a merchant ship hijacked in the Gulf of Aden is now held by Somali pirates.

events.title: The Israeli Air Force bombed Hamas infrastructure sites in the Gaza Strip overnight, the military says. The IDF says the targets included weapon depots, weapon manufacturing sites, and tunnels. The weapon depots were used to store assault rifles, RPGs, mortars, explosive devices, and other military equipment, according to the military. The IDF says Hamas "continues to systematically and blatantly violate the ceasefire agreement, while attempting to rebuild the organization's military capabilities and infrastructure."

events.title_en: Announcement of Arbaeen traffic restrictions in border provinces of the country
events.summary_en: Announcement of Arbaeen traffic restrictions in border provinces of the country. The chief of police traffic, announced the implementation of special traffic restrictions and prohibitions for Arbaeen Husseini on axes leading to the country's borders. He added: The transit of all motorcycles from 12 noon Thursday, 1st Mordad until 6 am Saturday, 17th Mordad on major highway axes in Kermanshah Province including Kangavar-Kermanshah, Kermanshah-Islam Abad West, Qasr-e Shirin-Kermanshah, Kamyaran-Islam Abad West and Hamil axis will be prohibited. Commander Karmi Asad continued: This restriction does not apply to police and rescue motorcycles that are authorised to transit on designated routes for essential missions.

events.summary_en: Ayatollah Mohseni Ezhei: Iran has no hostility with its neighbours. events.title: Cafés close, tolerance ends: Iran’s post-war shift on compulsory hijab

events.title_en: How did striking the Ali al-Salem base's infrastructure disrupt America's operational chain?
events.summary_en: How did striking the Ali al-Salem base's infrastructure disrupt America's operational chain? Ali al-Salem air base in Kuwait is one of the most important links in America's operational network in West Asia; a base that plays a central role in providing air support and logistics. In this video report, the process of a targeted strike on vital sections of this base and its consequences on the operational capacity of American forces are examined.

events.title_en: Qalibaf: The Zionist regime is the number one enemy of all Islamic countries
events.summary_en: Qalibaf: The Zionist regime is the number one enemy of all Islamic countries. The Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly, stating that the Zionist regime is undoubtedly the enemy of all Islamic countries, said: Cooperation between Iran and Iraq in order to preserve the unity of Islamic countries against the Zionist regime, which is the number one enemy of Muslims, is certainly effective. The speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly, while welcoming the Iraqi Prime Minister and his accompanying delegation, thanked the Iraqi nation and government for holding the grand funeral procession of the martyred leader of the revolution in Iraqi cities. Qalibaf, emphasising the history of Tehran-Baghdad relations, stated: Iran-Iraq cooperation is very effective on stability in the region and the sphere of Islamic countries.

events.title_en: Baghaei: Iran attaches special importance to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
events.summary_en: Baghaei: Iran attaches special importance to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation. According to the Foreign Ministry spokesman, Iran attaches special importance to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation and similar multilateral arrangements. At a time when combative unilateralism, covenant-breaking and resort to force are severely weakening the fundamental principles of the rule of law, the UN Charter and the legal order based on the Charter, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation and similar multilateral arrangements are seen as central and pioneering forces for genuine multilateralism.
